status: experimental fixture consumer; not a registered AIREP profile
ordering: Compare declared event ticks only within exact identity and an explicitly selected clock. Arrival time never orders source events. This fixture basis does not authenticate a real clock.
effect: Exact window match only. Conflicting observations of the same window remain indeterminate unless an explicitly authorized same-actor revision supersedes one. Quiescence reported is bounded to that window.
revision: Named earlier event, identical identity/kind/window/clock/source actor, later event time and observation time, configured revision authority; history is retained.
trust: Use existing AIREP Core and Authenticated verifier with caller-supplied operator inputs. Validate exact event bytes, exact referenced source bytes, and this basis digest. No URL or file dereferencing.
